name: codebase-consistency
description: Harmonize an already-modern, live codebase that grew inconsistent — divergent architecture, docs, code patterns, and style across modules — with a structured preflight / scan / map / canonize / brief / align / verify / status workflow. Derives the canonical form for undocumented, non-deprecated pattern variants (documented conventions and version-deprecated idioms are out of scope — see self-assess); an interactive consistency matrix; specialist agents; and optional dynamic-workflow orchestration with adversarial verification.
